newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian prime minister says Amman position on economic summit in Qatar depends on Middle East peace process.
- Iraq halts Syria's opposition radio in initiative towards rapprochement with Damascus.
- Saudi Arabian financier Adnan Khashoggi launches a $100 million Caucasus investment bank.
- Saudi British Bank posts 269.7 million riyal net profit in first six months of 1997.
- Saudi Arabia forms expanded 90-member Shura consultative council.
- Iranian president affirms full Iranian support for Syria.
- Assets of banks operating in United Arab Emirates exceed $52 billion.
- Morocco to launch first private airline on Monday.
